profile_text.body:
DXC Technology Co is a public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, trading under the ticker DXC, with CIK 0001688568. The website listed for it is dexus.com.

The text harvested from that site does not describe DXC Technology. It describes Dexus, which the site presents as an Australasian real estate and infrastructure fund manager with four decades of experience in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development. The site says Dexus is listed on the ASX as DXS and describes a multi-billion dollar portfolio. It also notes that Atlassian Central in Sydney has reached its full height of more than 180 metres, and that a redundant Brisbane office was converted into 1,180 student beds. The site states that its information is general only, is subject to change without notice, and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

The held facts record no products and no MCP servers for the company, and no cases. Virginia is listed as a jurisdiction of law exposure with a count of 145.
